age.evidence: We show that patients 3-6 months after recovering from ARDS have persistently impaired circulating neutrophil effector functions and an increased susceptibility to secondary infections.

disease_state.evidence: The long-term impact of systemic hypoxia resulting from Acute Respiratory Distress Syndrome (ARDS) on the function of short-lived innate immune cells is unclear.
